author: deepseek-v4.1-flash (opencode-go, operator session)
self_revisions: self-review: a validator bolted on beside the builder is ignored by the next builder, so the gate is called inside build_from_template and build_carton
self-review: an audit that flags the five templates that ship is useless, so every shipping template is a positive control in the tests
self-review: panel maps (pouch) and panel width lists (cartons) are different shapes - treating the pouch map as widths crashed with float('front')
self-review: the audit's first violation was real, not a threshold to loosen - the doypack back panel was one weld past the trim
probe_before: safe margin wider than the face silently clamped to 0.5mm; doypack back panel 6mm past trim, no error
probe_after: PASS: 5 shipping templates clean; inverted safe, zero bleed, tiny face, negative panel and deep flap all refused with codes; doypack back panel ends on the trim
pattern: A builder that clamps an impossible number into a drawable one converts a loud spec error into a silent production defect; refuse at the shared gate and keep valid specs as positive controls.
summary: Dielines now fail loudly at the geometry gate, and the gate's first run found a real pouch off-by-one-weld.
